name: International Scholarship Programme (ISP) — Avicenna-Studienwerk
requiredDocuments: Certificate of higher education entrance qualification (Abitur, A-Levels, etc.)
University certificate(s) and, if applicable, job references
Current certificate of enrolment (if available; otherwise submit immediately upon receipt)
For doctoral candidates only: a short synopsis of the dissertation project (max. 3 pages) covering topic, supervisor, research question, current status, expected results

timeline.notes: Most recent published cycle. Application window 01.03.–15.04.2026 for funding starting 1 October 2026; as of the 2026-06 anchor this window has closed and no later cycle has been published yet. Awarded annually — recheck the official ISP page for the next window.

benefits: Monthly basic scholarship of 844 EUR for Master's students (paid for the entire standard period of study; extension possible)
Optional monthly family allowance of 276 EUR (subject to conditions and fund availability)
One-time initial/book allowance of 100 EUR / 50 EUR (subject to conditions)
Internships and language courses may also be funded subject to fund availability
Non-material support: individual mentoring by an Avicenna adviser plus participation in seminars, study trips and regional group meetings
Scholarship does not have to be repaid
mustKnow: Muslim-focused programme: it supports international Muslim students; persons of other denominations may apply only in special cases (e.g. strong commitment to interfaith dialogue or a clear reference to Islam in their studies)
German proficiency at B2 level or above is required (exceptions possible) — per the DAAD database entry
You must already be enrolled in, or at least accepted for, a Master's at a state-recognised German university before/at application — admission is a prerequisite, not arranged by the scholarship
Bildungsinländer:innen (resident/'domestic' educational students who gained their university-entrance qualification in Germany) cannot be funded
Not eligible: Bachelor's programmes, part-time studies, and State examination (Staatsexamen) degrees
No double funding: you cannot hold another gifted-student/Begabtenförderung scholarship simultaneously, and a second Master's or second doctorate is excluded
Application open regardless of age, gender, or field of study
Funded by the German Federal Foreign Office (Auswärtiges Amt) via Avicenna-Studienwerk in cooperation with Islamkolleg Deutschland; DAAD lists 16 scholarships for the programme
Delivered as a living stipend (German public universities are largely tuition-free) — for a Master's student the rate is 844 EUR/month, not the higher doctoral rate
Family allowance (276 EUR/month) is a discretionary supplement granted only under certain conditions and subject to fund availability — not a guaranteed dependent benefit
Application documents may be submitted in German OR English; no IELTS/TOEFL or GRE is required by the programme

universities: Any state-recognised higher education institution in Germany

duration: Entire standard period of the Master's programme (Regelstudienzeit); extension possible. Doctorates funded for up to 3 years (36 months).
eligibleNationalities: International (non-domestic) Muslim students; Bangladesh is explicitly listed among the eligible countries of origin in the DAAD database eligibility filter. Bildungsinländer:innen (those with a German university-entrance qualification) are excluded.
languageRequirements: German language proficiency at B2 level or above; exceptions possible (per DAAD database). No IELTS/TOEFL requirement stated.
ageLimit: None — application is independent of age
applicationFee: Not stated by the programme; application is made via the Avicenna online portal
monthlyStipend: 844 EUR/month (Master's students) plus 100 EUR health-insurance + 100 EUR travel allowance
renewalConditions: Awarded for the standard study period; continued funding is subject to programme conditions and fund availability (extension possible).
